title: Connection refused versus timeout
summary: Use the observed connection outcome to choose the next network or service check.

concepts.title: Refusal
concepts.explanation: Usually indicates the destination path produced an active refusal, commonly because no service is listening or a policy rejects the connection.

concepts.title: Timeout
concepts.explanation: Indicates the expected response did not arrive within the client timeout; dropping, routing, reachability and overload remain possible.

concepts.title: Application health
concepts.explanation: A successful TCP connection does not prove the application protocol or business function is healthy.

limitations: DNS, TLS, proxy and application errors are separate layers.
Firewall behavior can reject or silently drop traffic depending on policy.
